notes.title: Wings of Endless is now out!
notes.content:
[h2]The wait is over!
[/h2]

[b]Wings of Endless[/b], the thrilling new pixel-art[b] Action RPG[/b] created by solo dev [b]Isoca Games[/b], is finally available on Steam!

Step into the shoes of Hariku, a reckless bounty hunter caught in the echoes of a long-lost war. Explore a massive world filled with secrets, dangerous enemies, ancient puzzles, and powerful gear. Swap between three unique heroes in real time and unleash devastating combos in fast-paced battles.

Your journey begins now—are you ready to spread your wings?

[h3]🎮 Fully playable on Steam Deck! ✅
[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666610?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=steamevent
